d:
Makkhi (Eega) is the story of Jani, a kind-hearted man murdered by a jealous millionaire Sudeep, who desires the same woman, Bindu. Reborn as a housefly, Jani joins forces with Bindu to seek revenge, using clever and creative ways to torment Sudeep until justice is served. Filled with stunning visuals, emotion, and imagination, this Hindi Dubbed Action Fantasy Blockbuster starring Nani, Samantha, and Sudeepa is a one-of-a-kind tale where revenge truly takes flight!
